extractions.justification: First, I reviewed each expression in the list to determine if it contains an acronym or abbreviation. 'pdes' is an abbreviation for 'partial differential equations', and since both are present in the list, they were paired together. Similarly, 'pinns' stands for 'physics-informed neural networks' which is also included, so they were paired as well. The remaining expressions, 'mathematics & theory' and 'physics-inferred neural networks', do not contain any acronyms or abbreviations and are therefore listed under 'others'.
